svg.title: KCNyu live investment instance built with clawock contracts
svg.desc: This is the KCNyu deployment, not the reusable clawock product architecture. Python assembles one immutable evidence pack. OpenClaw agents run four analyst lenses, a bull case, a bear case and three risk voices, and a judge names the strategy frame and writes plan.json. A Python decision contract validates plan.json and the brief sections, and flags any risk breach the plan ignores, before the brief, ledger and dashboard publish it. On the return path code triggers each call against canonical unadjusted daily bars, groups repeated calls into episodes, grades them against a directional baseline and publishes the scorecard, which feeds the next brief.

text.tspan: brief sections: tiers 1–3, judge, next session
a risk breach the plan ignores is flagged
